Jules H: quick sync re: Polaris onboarding + SLO exposure ahead of renewal. 30d uptime 99.78% vs 99.9 contract, p95 latency 360ms vs 250ms. customer asking for credit calc and remediation plan.
Ravi S: ack. early signal: two short cache-churn windows after their large prefix upload. kv_hit dropped ~20% during those windows; autoscaler bumped to fallback model once.
Toni B: thanks. can we get exact windows and call counts so credits are prorated correctly? also we should list unfinished enablement tasks to offer as remediation (ops workshop + latency tuning).
Ravi S: pulling query now, will paste small excerpt.
Ravi S: logs:
```
2026-03-02T09:14Z route=us model=redwood-v1 kv_hit=0.77 req_ms=340
2026-03-02T09:20Z route=us model=redwood-v1 kv_hit=0.54 req_ms=520
```
Ravi S: total affected window ~8m, affected_calls ~120k.
Jules H: provisional credit calc: using contract formula, looks like ~2% capped at contract 5%. propose offering 2% + 30d timeline with an ops workshop to finish remaining 2 onboarding items.
Toni B: agree. prepare a one-page evidence bundle (incident IDs, logs, calc) and a short customer note: apology, explanation, credit, remediation, ops invite. I'll review before sending.
OpsBot: incident POL-675 created by @Ravi S — https://incidents.redwood/internal/POL-675
Jules H: i'll draft the email and schedule the workshop. goal: send by EOD and have the workshop scheduled next week.
